newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Richter recovers from Friday's plunge.
newsitem.headline: Richter recovers from Friday's plunge.

text.p: Shares in Hungarian pharmaceuticals company Richter Gedeon Rt on Monday regained some of Friday's 3.5 percent loss in light volume, traders said.
At 1050 GMT Richter shares traded at 15,600 forints, up 300 from Friday's close of 15,300.

Richter shares on Friday tumbled 3.5 percent after newspapers reported that Denco LaboratorIes Ltd of the U.S. filed a suit against Richter for pulling out of its contract to manufacture a French abortion pill. The news triggered a selling wave in the shares.

"I don't see the reason behind Friday's panic as the share issue prospectus (in Richter's recent offering) included the information of the lawsuit," one trader said. "Friday's fall was unfounded, I think this recovery is realistic," the trader said.
